subject: Mutual Action Plan: Kickoff + technical introductions (Attune Health)
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@attunehealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: Kickoff + technical introductions (Attune Health)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, I’m kicking off a short MAP to align on scope, evaluation goals, roles, and a realistic close timeline for the pilot with Attune Health. I’ve looped in our Solutions Engineer and ML Engineer so we can get a technical sync scheduled this week.

Quick context (one-liner): Attune is validating a conversational triage flow and embeddings-based search over clinical notes with a ~6-8 week evaluation horizon. Goal is to measure latency and cost per 1M tokens as well as relevance metrics on held-out prompts.

Proposed immediate asks:
- Can you confirm primary technical contact(s) and whether the eval will run in your VPC or with Redwood-hosted sandbox?
- We attached a draft MAP and a simple evaluation-plan template — please review and flag gaps.
- Suggested timeline (flexible): kickoff tech sync this week -> eval kickoff next week -> 6-week runway -> decision meeting w/ procurement end of April.

Dylan (SE) — can you introduce yourself and share a short agenda for the tech sync (what we need from Attune to get token-level perf and KV/cache tests)?
Dev (ML Eng) — will help scope dataset/quantization/latency tradeoffs — can you confirm typical hardware we’ll recommend for Attune’s profile?

Olivia / Samir — what days/times work this week for a 45-minute technical kickoff? We’ve put a couple of tentative slots in the MAP doc.

Attachments: Attune_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft), evaluation-plan-templates.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
www.redwood.ai

Aisha — thanks for the clear note and the MAP draft. Samir (engineering lead) and I are on board to run a short pilot. I’ll give you quick answers to your asks: we plan to run initial evals in a Redwood-hosted sandbox to avoid VPN setup delays; if things look good we’ll move to our VPC for production testing.

Samir will be the technical lead and I’ve CC’d him for any calendar coordination.

Availability for a 45-min tech sync: Friday 3/6 10:30–11:15am PT or Monday 3/9 1:00–1:45pm PT. Please pick one and include dial-in.

We had a quick read of the MAP and added comments in the Google Doc (link in my signature). I’ll also upload sample de-identified notes to the shared bucket once we confirm the sync.

Thanks,
Olivia Hart
Head of Clinical Platforms | Attune Health

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: Kickoff + technical introductions (Attune Health)

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Thanks for the quick reply — Dylan here (Solutions Engineer). Quick intro: I help customers validate latency and throughput assumptions and run the token-level experiments that feed the MAP. For this sync I propose a 45-min agenda:

1) Goals & success metrics (5 min) — confirm latency SLO, relevance metrics, and cost target
2) Data + access (10 min) — format of de-identified notes, sample size, and whether you’ll share the S3 link or we pull from sandbox
3) Eval infra (10 min) — hosting mode (Redwood sandbox vs Attune VPC), expected qps and peak concurrency
4) Tests we’ll run (10 min) — warm KV cache vs cold start, continuous batching profiles, and quantization ablations
5) Next steps & owners (10 min) — timeline for artifactual runs and handoff to procurement/CS

Two technical asks before the meeting that help shorten the first session:
- Can you confirm typical sequence length (median & 95th pct) and dataset size (number of documents/avg tokens)?
- Any compliance constraints (e.g., additional logging disabled, retention windows) that would affect using Redwood-hosted sandbox?

Recommended hardware baseline for the pilot: 1x A10G or T4 equivalent for functional evals; if you want to stress throughput we’ll recommend reserved capacity (Dedicated) with 2–4x A100-class for realistic production-level perf. Dev can chime in on quantization options.

Requested slot: I can do Friday 3/6 10:30am PT. If you prefer Monday 3/9 1pm PT I’m available then too. Dial-in: Zoom (https://redwood.zoom.us/j/987654321). I’ll post a calendar invite after we confirm.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Perfect — thank you all. Friday 3/6 slot worked great for the SE; since Samir chose Monday 3/9 1:00–1:45pm PT, we’ll lock that in and I’ve just sent the calendar invite to everyone.

Next steps (summary, please reply with thumbs up or edits):
- Tech kickoff: Mon 3/9 1:00–1:45pm PT (Dylan, Dev, Samir) — agenda as above.
- MAP: see attached Attune_MAP_v1.pdf. Olivia — please add Samir’s procurement contact in the MAP so we can include procurement milestones in week 3.
- Eval artifacts: Olivia to upload de-identified notes to the shared bucket before EOD 3/10.
- Redwood deliverables (week 1–2): baseline perf report, KV cache test results, cost projection for 1M tokens.
- Decision checkpoint: target week of 2026-04-27 for internal Attune decision; we’ll set a pre-decision readout the week prior.

Attachments: Attune_MAP_v1.pdf, evaluation-plan-templates.xlsx

If there are any scheduling conflicts please flag ASAP. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
